analysis.insight_summary: Users continue to encounter upgrade errors when updating from [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] [version_no], even after following advice such as running the application as an administrator. The ongoing nature of these issues led to the creation of dedicated support documentation, highlighting this as a consistent user experience problem. Solutions suggested by the community have not fully resolved the main issue.
